findings.description: Direct inspection of the current neutral, sit and crouch renders shows exposed gray upper-thigh/body surface and incomplete shorts coverage. The source-skin-weight shell improves the measured diagnostic relative to V90 but still covers only 55.03% of each evaluated upper thigh in crouch and sit; neutral is 68.59%. These prototype ray-coverage measurements are not fit acceptance.

Direct inspection of front, back, left, right and three-quarter views shows dense stepped side ridges and projecting hem corners. In sit and crouch, the overskirt splays into sharp triangular flaps and the front panel hangs between or behind the legs.

Geometry audit reports avatarFitVerified and buildReportPassed failed. The renders do not establish usable fit, calibrated weights, Shape Key response, UV completion, Unity/VRChat execution or release readiness. This prototype is rejected and remains non-releaseable.

nextAction: Replace the partial surface-copied thigh shells with a continuous assembled shorts garment that closes around both legs and through the gusset, then redesign the overskirt side/hem topology and deformation. Rebuild from the canonical checkpoint and inspect fresh pose-matched evidence; retain the rejection until each quality gate is independently met.
